name: bypass_encrypt
purpose: Encrypt data/bypasses/*.jsonl at-rest to prevent exfiltration of attack patterns. Uses Fernet symmetric encryption (cryptography library). Key derived from SCP_ENCRYPTION_KEY env var or generated + persisted to data/.encryption_key.
interfaces: def encrypt_file(self, filepath: Path) -> Path  # returns backup path
def rotate_key(self) -> None  # re-encrypt all bypasses with new key
